description: Adaptive compensation parameters for SO-101 Robot 0 (auto-calibrated)
_z_offset_comment: Per-robot pick/place z offset (meters, signed). Added to BOTH execute_pick_object and execute_place_object commanded z. Positive = raise (descend less), negative = descend further. 2026-05-23: +0.04 → 0.0 (neutralized after robot0 recalibration; observe new sag baseline before re-tuning).
_pick_xy_offset_comment: Pick-only radial xy offset (meters, signed). Pushes pick xy outward along base→object direction. Positive = further from base, negative = closer. Applied at execute_pick_object AND pull_object (shared helper). 2026-05-23: +0.03 → +0.01 (3cm was over-shooting drawer handles).
_pick_offset_comment: Per-robot pick depth from object top (meters). pick_z = object_height − pick_offset + z_offset + sag_offset. Larger = grip higher on object. 2026-05-25: 0.0 → 0.02 (close-lid task: grip lid handle 2cm above its top for safer pinch).

gravity_sag._comment: Hand-tuned over auto-cal (auto fit settled at base_sag=0 because no-payload calibration data was ~6mm at low z; production pick with payload showed 14.7mm at reach=0.27). base_sag=0.20 + reach_power=2.0 reproduces the 14.7mm pick-region observation while preserving cantilever-style reach^2 scaling. gain=0.24 retained for high-z extra droop.
